summary: iter350 Phase 3/4/5 backlog fully tested. Backend: 17/17 passing (pytest test_iter350_phase345.py) covering pay-periods anchor/frequency math, XLSX template with no wage/rate columns + upload roundtrip, canonical-period timesheet submit+approve, badge-less checkpoint scan by phone / in-app id / junk, kiosk lookup + qr-scan, social compliance yearly (365-day) sponsored threshold, social multi-select support types with validation, and Claude Sonnet 4.6 sponsor-story generate + hand-edit save. Frontend: HR Timesheets tab shows dropdown period filter (combobox, NOT month input) for ts-period-filter, log-for-period, xlsx-period; XLSX dialog blurb explicitly states 'Pay rates and wage types are never printed on timesheets'; HR settings 'Pay period start anchor' (period-anchor-date, type=date) present with copy about existing timesheets/payslips; Portal timesheet dialog uses ts-period-select combobox + ts-period-days grid + 14 ts-day-* buttons (biweekly); Social work case dialog Overview tab shows cd-support-needed and cd-support-given chip pickers (School fees + Food, Medical toggle states matched the backend PUT); cd-sponsor-story-panel with toggle/generate/save/text data-testids all present and the story panel shows Claude Sonnet 4.6 generated content + persisted hand-edit; Chat org chart is expanded-by-default and renders `SYSTEM ADMINS · 2` (Admin User + Silvester Lubwama) at the TOP under data-testid org-level-system-admin, then Director, then Manager — no Other bucket, no admins in Other. No Executive Director / Adviser users exist in the seeded data, so the ED-above-Adviser sub-ordering could not be exercised, but the ORG_LEVELS array in CommsPage.jsx has them in the correct order (System Admin → ED → Adviser → Director → …).

minor.issue: When there are zero active child cases the response omitted `threshold_days` and `sponsored_threshold_days`. Fixed inline (compliance.py early-return now includes both fields).

critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/hr.py is 3975 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline; consider splitting timesheets/payslips/settings into sub-routers.
backend/routers/social_work.py is 1732 lines — same guideline concern; the SUPPORT_TYPES/_clean_support_list block would sit better in a small support_types module.
backend/routers/social_review_forms/compliance.py — the empty-case early return was silently dropping the summary threshold fields; a return-shape unit test would prevent regressions.

backend/routers/security_checkpoint/_common.py — `_resolve_by_identifier` builds a large $or with both raw + upper-case variants for every column; a case-insensitive collation index would be cleaner and faster.

backend/routers/events.py::qr_code_checkin requires `get_current_user` — the review request expected it to work like a badge scan without an operator, but it currently 401s unauthenticated. Not a bug per spec (kiosks always run as an authenticated operator today) but worth noting.
